label_provenance: Organizer statement relayed directly by project owner: first real recording contains one person, remaining supplied real tunnels contain no obstacles. Synthetic organizer bag is separate. This is not exhaustive per-point human annotation.

continuous_negative_recording.file_hash_source: data/extended_full/extraction.json; hashes retained from extraction, sizes checked now; not claiming all 87GB were rehashed.

deduplication: extended_subset new_data_0/100/200 are aliases/subsets of continuous recording segments, never additional independent negatives. Original six bags are separate recordings; no inter-bag independence assumption.
split_policy: Contiguous full-recording segments 0..139 development and 140..220 frozen evaluation. Segment200 and several other intervals were already inspected; no blind holdout claim. Do not use evaluation background for synthetic tuning.

initial_regression_gate.scope: Initial fixed regression subset, NOT completion of full20-minute evaluation or issue21.

organizer_synthetic.negative_claim: Only post-insertion tail has no inferred inserted points; outside cases5/7 are contour-disagreement cases, not silently assumed clean.

episode_definition.unit: contiguous frame-level confirmed-intersection alarm interval, independent of track ID
episode_definition.end: first observed non-alarm frame, recording end, or acquisition gap above configured frame_max_gap_s
episode_definition.exposure: Sum acquisition intervals not exceeding frame_max_gap_s; report excluded gap time separately, never interpret missing scans as clear route.
episode_definition.limits: No events/km without independently qualified odometric denominator; no field obstacle recall from one person.
